{
  "command": "ui_set_slot_layout",
  "params": {
    "widget_blueprint_path": "string (required) — Full path of the target Widget Blueprint",
    "widget_name": "string (required) — Name of the widget whose SLOT is being laid out",
    "anchors_min": "number (required)[] (optional) — Canvas: min anchor [X, Y] in 0-1 screen fractions",
    "anchors_max": "number (required)[] (optional) — Canvas: max anchor [X, Y] in 0-1 screen fractions",
    "anchors": "union (optional) — Canvas: anchors as [minX, minY, maxX, maxY] or {min:[x,y], max:[x,y]}. Sugar for anchors_min + anchors_max.",
    "position": "number (required)[] (optional) — Canvas: position [X, Y] in px relative to the anchor",
    "size": "number (required)[] (optional) — Canvas: size [Width, Height] in px",
    "alignment": "number (required)[] (optional) — Canvas: pivot [X, Y] in 0-1 (0.5,0.5 centres on the position)",
    "auto_size": "bool (optional) — Canvas: size to the widget’s desired size instead of the explicit size",
    "z_order": "number (optional) — Canvas: draw order among siblings (higher draws on top)",
    "padding": "union (optional) — Box/grid/overlay/border/size-box slots: padding as a single number, [L,T,R,B], or {left,top,right,bottom}. Zero is honoured, so this can clear padding.",
    "fill": "number (optional) — Horizontal/VerticalBox slots: fill weight. 0 means size-to-content.",
    "horizontal_alignment": "\"Fill\"|\"Left\"|\"Center\"|\"Right\" (optional) — Alignment within the slot",
    "vertical_alignment": "\"Fill\"|\"Top\"|\"Center\"|\"Bottom\" (optional) — Alignment within the slot",
    "row": "number (optional) — Grid/UniformGrid slots: row index",
    "column": "number (optional) — Grid/UniformGrid slots: column index",
    "row_span": "number (optional) — Grid slots: rows spanned",
    "column_span": "number (optional) — Grid slots: columns spanned"
  },
  "returns": "{succeeded, failed}",
  "cost": "low"
}

{
  "command": "ui_query",
  "params": {
    "path": "string (required) — Full path of the Widget Blueprint to inspect, e.g. \"/Game/Aphrosia/UI/WBP_StartScreen\"",
    "include_properties": "bool (optional, default: false) — Include widget properties in the response",
    "include_guid": "bool (optional, default: false) — Include GUIDs in the response",
    "include_slot": "bool (optional, default: true) — Include slot layout info in the response",
    "name_pattern": "string (optional) — Case-sensitive substring a widget name must contain. Returns a flat `matches` list instead of the tree.",
    "class_filter": "string (optional) — Class a widget must be or derive from, e.g. \"PanelWidget\" for every panel. Returns a flat `matches` list instead of the tree.",
    "flatten": "bool (optional) — Return the flat `matches` list even when no filter is given."
  },
  "returns": "{path, parent_class, root:{name, class, slot, guid?, properties?, children:[…]}}",
  "cost": "low"
}
